r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change extend compact validation for issue-292 observability surfaces within allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside run_pipeline_validation.py + test_pipeline_validation.py and respect exclusions (no model/training/objective changes, no docs)? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it demonstrate missing-field failures name field and owning artifact? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet handoff constraints: compact, committed-artifacts-only, no bulky outputs? Record pass/fail with a finding.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from recorded architecture in a way the Pilot must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag triage if out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: Committed unc_diag artifact lacks g1 summary counters; recorded as blocker not gate weakening.

r6-baseline-comparisons.title: Baseline comparisons gate
r6-baseline-comparisons.imperative: Verify compact validation requires module baseline_comparisons with expected delta keys in gold details.

r7-uncertainty-calibration.title: Uncertainty calibration gate
r7-uncertainty-calibration.imperative: Verify compact validation requires module uncertainty_calibration diagnostics (correlations, bins, flags) in gold details.

r8-runtime-parity.title: Runtime/training parity gate
r8-runtime-parity.imperative: Verify compact validation requires runtime_training_parity with parity_status and parity_flags in gold details modules.

r9-event-usage.title: Event usage gate
r9-event-usage.imperative: Verify compact validation requires event_usage rows with required_inputs, missing_inputs, scored, and skipped reporting.

r10-soft-diagnostic-flags.title: Soft/diagnostic flags gate
r10-soft-diagnostic-flags.imperative: Verify compact validation requires soft_flags on gold details modules and diagnostic_flags on module uncertainty diagnostics entries.

r11-unc-diag-artifact.title: Module uncertainty diagnostics artifact
r11-unc-diag-artifact.imperative: Verify gold details references a resolvable module_uncertainty_diagnostics_json artifact with summary counters and module diagnostic_flags.

r12-failure-messages.title: Failure message specificity
r12-failure-messages.imperative: Verify validation failures name the missing field and owning artifact (gold details, gold module uncertainty diagnostics, etc.).

r13-protected-intent.title: Protected intent
r13-protected-intent.imperative: Verify no model training, calibration math, objective, or recursive behavior changes.

r14-no-docs.title: No docs changes
r14-no-docs.imperative: Verify docs were not modified (g3 scope). Record pass/fail with a finding.

r15-focused-tests.title: Focused tests
r15-focused-tests.imperative: Run py -m pytest tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_pipeline_validation.py -v or record why not run.

triage_candidates.statement: Regenerate committed unc_diag artifact after g1 summary counter additions so compact validation passes on repo baseline.
